name: Shanghai Porigine Chemical Material Group Co. Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Porigine Chemical Material Group Co. Ltd. engages in design, production, and sale of clothing products for women in China. The company sells its products through distribution, joint marketing, direct sales, and network channels. Shanghai Porigine Chemical Material Group Co. Ltd. was formerly known as Ribo Fashion Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shanghai Porigine Chemical Material Group Co. Ltd. in March 2026. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Shanghai, China.
